papers.title: VISTA: A Visual Harness for Reasoning in an Interactive World
papers.abstract: We show that multimodal models possess strong reasoning abilities and that an appropriate harness can unlock their potential to solve tasks across diverse interactive environments. We introduce VISTA, a visual harness that gives a general-purpose multimodal model long-horizon vision. VISTA allows the model to directly perceive the environment through visual observations and maintains a lossless visual memory that preserves past observations in their original form. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.02200）：VISTA 是 visual harness ——给 general-purpose multimodal model 配备'long-horizon vision'，让它直接通过 visual observation 感知 environment，并用 lossless visual memory 保留 past observations 的原始形态（preserves model support, lossless visual memory），同时允许模型主动 retrieve 过去 observation。是 ai-agent × multimodal-agent × context-engineering 的'long-horizon visual memory harness'即时资产——把'视觉感知'从'static prompt'拉到'first-class memory asset + active retrieval'；与昨日 / 上周 multimodal-agent 主线（ScholarCatalyst、3D harness 等）在'visual memory as first-class asset'层面同源；与 aiutil 长期关注的 context-engineering × memory 主线在'long-horizon lossless memory'层面同源（视觉分支）。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 active retrieval protocol、lossless visual memory 实现（raw frame store vs compressed）、跨 multimodal model 兼容、与现有 agent harness（LangChain / AutoGen 等）集成。今日动作：即时试点方向，写'vista long-horizon visual memory' checklist 草稿。

papers.title: TACO: Ternary Absolute-max Column-wise One-sparse Optimizer for LLM Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract: Full-parameter fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) incurs substantial optimizer state memory overhead, limiting the model sizes that fit on modern GPUs. Existing approaches either compress optimizer state, abandon first-order gradients, or change the update geometry while retaining dense state. The recently introduced Muon optimizer reduces optimizer memory through matrix-valued updates. Still, its geometry differs from AdamW and can lead to performance degradation when fine-tuning AdamW
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.02199）：TACO（Ternary Absolute-max Column-wise One-sparse Optimizer）解决 LLM full-parameter fine-tuning 的 optimizer state 内存瓶颈——既不放弃 first-order gradient（不像 sign-SGD 类方法），也保留 AdamW 风格 update geometry（不像 Muon 把几何改成 matrix-valued）；用 ternary quantization + absolute-max column-wise one-sparse 把 optimizer state 内存压下来。是 inference-serving × memory × llm-evaluation 的'ternary one-sparse optimizer state'即时资产——'optimizer state memory as governance object'是 LLM training/serving 关键的内存维度，与昨日 / 上周 KV-cache / linear-attention recurrent state 量化主线在'把 LLM memory 维度变成可量化工程对象'层面同源；与 aiutil 长期关注的 inference-serving × memory × context-engineering 主线高度对齐。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 ternary quantization scheme 形式化、column-wise one-sparse 实现、跨 AdamW / Muon baseline 对照、跨 LLM 规模验证。今日动作：即时路线资产，写'taco ternary-optimizer-state' checklist 草稿。

papers.title: Reconstruct, Practice, Go Real: Guided Self-Improvement for Embodied Agents
papers.abstract: Building reliable robot capabilities across diverse tasks requires substantial human effort to develop and maintain skills, design rewards, and integrate perception with control. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.02204）：Reconstruct, Practice, Go Real (RPG) 是 embodied agent 的 'offline dataset → sim practice → real' 自改进框架，核心亮点是'不更新 model weights'，靠 execution feedback + privileged simulator state 在 simulation 内构造 practice tasks 提升 robot execution。是 ai-agent × multimodal-agent × coding-agent 的'embodied self-improvement without weight update'趋势资产——'agent improvement from offline + sim without retraining'范式可迁移到任何 agent self-improvement 场景（coding agent 的 practice-on-itil、tool-use agent 的 paper-on-pil 等）；与昨日 / 上周 ai-agent × RL training 主线在'agent 提升不靠 retrain'层面同源；与今日 VISTA、TACO 在'agent memory / training memory as governance object'层面同源。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 practice task 构造协议、privileged state 设计、跨 robot task 验证、sim-to-real transfer 细节。今日动作：趋势卡片维护，写'rpg practice-on-itil' checklist 草稿。

papers.title: KaliBench: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Cybersecurity Tool Use on Kali Linux with Runtime-Free Verifiable Rewards
papers.abstract: LLMs are increasingly applied to cybersecurity workflows, where they are expected to translate analysts' intent into tool invocations. However, existing evaluations focus on knowledge-based assessments or end-to-end agentic tasks, and do not directly measure LLMs' ability to generate executable commands for real-world cybersecurity tools. This gap is critical because cybersecurity operations rely on strict command-line interfaces (CLIs), where minor syntax errors, incorrect flag--value bindings,
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.02206）：KaliBench 是 cybersecurity tool use benchmark，运行在 Kali Linux，明确点出'real-world cybersecurity operations rely on strict command-line interfaces (CLIs), where minor syntax errors, incorrect flag-value bindings' 等痛点；并配 runtime-free verifiable rewards（无运行代价的可验证奖励），把 agents 与终点栈拉到 'strict-syntax CLI invocation' 评测层级。是 llm-evaluation × ai-agent × security-governance 的'strict-syntax tool-use benchmark'趋势资产——'runtime-free verifiable reward + strict CLI syntax'范式可迁移到任何 'tool-use agent benchmark' 子方向（DevOps / DB admin / cloud CLI 等）；与 aiutil 长期关注的 ai-agent × llm-evaluation × security-governance 主线高度对齐。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 CLI 覆盖范围、reward 形式化、跨 LLM baseline、'runtime-free' 实现细节。今日动作：趋势卡片维护。

papers.title: Embedding Prediction Helps Image Generation
papers.abstract: In diffusion transformers, a class label or a text prompt is embedded once, and the same condition is reused at every denoising step. We ask whether predicted embeddings can serve as this condition instead. Next-Embedding Predictive Autoregression (NEPA) trains a Transformer to predict the next continuous embedding in a sequence. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.02203）：NEPA（Next-Embedding Predictive Autoregression）挑战 'in diffusion transformers, a class label or text prompt is embedded once, and the same condition is reused at every denoising step' 的现状，把'diffusion transformer 的 condition'从'static embedding reuse'推到'predicted next-embedding'：用 Transformer 预测 next continuous embedding，生成时'clean image follows noisy image'，所以 clean image embedding 是 condition 与 noisy image embedding 的 next embedding。是 inference-serving × multimodal-agent × ai-agent 的'predicted-embedding condition'趋势资产——'next-embedding prediction as diffusion condition'范式可迁移到 video / 3D diffusion 与 multimodal-to-multimodal 生成；与 aiutil 长期关注的 inference-serving × multimodal-agent 主线在'generation condition as predicted embedding'层面同源。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 NEPA 架构、跨 diffusion backbone 验证、inference cost 与 static embedding baseline 对照。今日动作：趋势卡片维护。

papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.02202）：ScholarCatalyst 是 'what papers inspired which papers' 的 IR benchmark ——把'伟大科学家知道哪个 earlier work 推进了他们已完成的项目'这个隐式知识，通过 author-annotated pipeline（作者亲自标注）变成可大规模构建的 benchmark。是 llm-evaluation × rag-knowledge × ai-agent 的'author-annotated inspiration benchmark'长尾理论资产——'科学家筛选灵感 paper 的能力可被 benchmark 化'是 IR × RAG × agent 的元层评估范式；与 aiutil 长期关注的 rag-knowledge × llm-evaluation × ai-agent 主线在'IR evaluation beyond relevance'层面同源（与昨日 Ranking-Aware Prompt Optimization 同属'evaluation target diversity'路线）。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 annotation 协议、跨领域 paper 覆盖、IR system baseline、与现有 citation graph benchmark 差异。今日动作：长尾卡片维护。

papers.title: SILSA: Sliding-Window Slice Latents for Topology-Preserving High-Resolution 3D Generation
papers.abstract: High-resolution 3D generation increasingly relies on voxel latents and multi-stage pipelines that first predict active structure and then synthesize local geometry. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.02201）：SILSA 用 sliding-window slice latents 做 topology-preserving 高分辨率 3D generation，明确指出'voxel latents + multi-stage pipelines fragment continuous surfaces into many local tokens, inflate generation cost, and weaken topological consistency'，用 compact sliding-window slice latents 解决。是 multimodal-agent × inference-serving × memory 的'sliding-window slice 3D latent'长尾架构资产——'topology-preserving + sliding-window latent'范式可迁移到任意'高分辨率体素生成 / 大 3D scene'子方向；与今日 NEPA 在'diffusion condition design'层面相邻；与昨日 / 上周 multimodal-agent × 3D / world model 主线在'3D generation architecture'层面同源。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 sliding-window 协议、slice latent 拼接、topology consistency metric、与现有 voxel latent baseline 对照。今日动作：长尾卡片维护。

papers.title: FERPO: Forward Entropy-Regularized Policy Optimization
papers.abstract: Several state-of-the-art methods for online reinforcement learning in continuous control improve policies using action gradients of a learned critic. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.02198）：FERPO（Forward Entropy-Regularized Policy Optimization）挑战'critics 训练预测 returns，但 accurate value prediction 不一定 yield accurate action derivatives'，提出 on-policy maximum entropy RL 算法绕过 critic 在 action-derivative 上的失败。是 inference-serving × multimodal-agent × llm-evaluation 的'forward entropy-regularized on-policy RL'长尾理论资产——'critic accuracy ≠ action derivative accuracy' 是 RL 训练稳定性的核心痛点，'forward entropy regularization' 路线为绕过 critic 提供具体范式；与今日 RPG 在'agent self-improvement without retraining'层面互补（RPG 走 sim practice、FERPO 走 actor-only gradient）。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 forward entropy 形式化、on-policy 收敛保证、跨 continuous control benchmark、actor-only baseline 对照。今日动作：长尾卡片维护。

papers.title: Cost-augmented Schrödinger bridges on graphs are exactly solvable: a Feynman-Kac tilt replaces learned control
papers.abstract: The generalized Schrödinger bridge on a graph moves mass between two distributions while charging a cost for the states visited. It has been approached by learning the rates of a controlled continuous-time Markov chain, with a temporal-difference penalty that restores the cost. A state cost folds into the reference process as a Feynman-Kac tilt. The cost-augmented bridge is then a plain bridge against the tilted reference, and the penalty is unnecessary. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.02195）：Cost-augmented Schrödinger bridges on graphs 用 Feynman-Kac tilt 把 'generalized Schrödinger bridge with state cost' 变成 'plain bridge against tilted reference'，证明 the bridge is computed exactly by alternation，替代 learned control（TD penalty）。是 inference-serving × llm-evaluation 的'exact-solvable cost-augmented bridge'长尾理论资产——'Feynman-Kac tilt 替代 learned control'是 generative model 与 control 的元层方法学；与 aiutil 长期关注的 inference-serving × llm-evaluation 主线在'graph / diffusion generative model'层面同源。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 tilt 形式化、alternation 算法、跨 graph size 验证、与 learned TD control baseline 对照。今日动作：长尾卡片维护。

papers.title: One Basis to Animate Them All: Gaussian Blendshape Distillation for Real-Time Avatars
papers.abstract: 3D Gaussian avatars support fast rendering, however, their real-time animation is often challenged by the costly neural inference. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.02207）：GALA（Gaussian Animation via Linear Approximation）把 3D Gaussian avatar 的实时 animation 从'costly neural inference'推到'identity-independent blendshapes 的 linear combination + shallow coefficient predictor'，即用 distillation 把 heavy decoder 换成 linear blend。是 multimodal-agent × inference-serving × context-engineering 的'Gaussian avatar linear-blend distillation'长尾架构资产——'identity-independent linear blend as real-time avatar'范式可迁移到其他 3D Gaussian avatar 与实时渲染场景；与今日主线稍偏视觉 avatar（cs.HC），与 VISTA / NEPA / SILSA 同属 multimodal 长尾主线但密度较低。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 blendshape 数量、coefficient predictor 协议、跨 avatar 验证、与现有 real-time avatar baseline 对照。今日动作：长尾卡片维护。
